findings.body: The standard requires: “Remove what your own change left unused.” `hasProviderResumeHandle` is imported here but never referenced. `eslint.config.js:75` configures `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` as an error, so this added import prevents `npm run lint:changed` and the close command from passing. Remove the import and the newly added `session-resume-handle.ts`, which has no remaining callers and is outside the task’s scope without serving the quiet-window behavior.
findings.title: Standard: Remove what your own change left unused
